[Read more →](https://docs.trysignalbase.com/) [Funding news](https://www.trysignalbase.com/news/funding)·Published March 24, 2026 Get the full Trackforce company profile Access contacts, investors, buying signals & more [Open in Dashboard](https://www.trysignalbase.com/dashboard) [United States funding roundup, week of2026-03-30: 249 verifiedrounds →](https://www.trysignalbase.com/news/funding/funding-rounds-united-states-week-of-2026-03-30) Trackforce has secured $45.0 million in new investment capital from investors. This funding round marks a significant milestone for the company, which operates at the forefront of the physical security industry. Trackforce combines over 40 years of collective security expertise with an end-to-end cloud platform and open API ecosystem. This robust platform empowers guarding companies and corporate enterprises across more than 50 countries to protect their assets, people, and operations with enhanced efficiency and effectiveness. The company is trusted by over 4,600 customers and manages more than 200,000 security sites globally. The capital infusion is intended to accelerate Trackforce's product development roadmap, particularly in advanced AI technologies, and to expand its global market presence. The company maintains high standards of compliance, including SOC2, NIST, GDPR, and ISO, and supports over 55 languages, ensuring seamless integrations within diverse security operations. By incorporating advanced AI, Trackforce aims to anticipate and address evolving security challenges, setting new standards for the industry. This funding round positions Trackforce to further innovate beyond current security challenges and continue its trajectory of growth. The company plans to leverage this investment to strengthen its offerings and extend its reach, reinforcing its commitment to delivering cutting-edge solutions for the physical security sector.
